name: masters-pods-shelf/bench-b
refs: THE LAYOUT (a flat wireframe, project-owned), the WHOLE canvas edge to edge: the wall above; the bench top as a narrow band just below the middle of the picture (at 44 to 47 percent of the height) across the full width, with the bench front below it filling the lower half; the low brass lamp hood upper left, hanging on a stem from the top edge, its bottom at about one sixth of the height; its warm pool of light on the bench top (the yellow ellipse). Take only the placement and the heights, exactly. Never copy its flat look or its outlines.

THE CABINET (our painted pod cabinet, project-owned): this exact aged umber wood and cream plaster, the same finish and warmth. The reading bench is made of the same wood, and the wall behind is the same plaster.

THE PAINTED LANGUAGE (one of our signed room paintings, project-owned): its matte painterly miniature rendering, soft occlusion, warm golden light and cosy depth. Take the treatment and the warmth only.
prompt:
Paint the backdrop of a quiet reading room in a cosy naturalist's home, for a handheld game screen, 16:9, seen front-on at the height of the bench: a long, plain reading bench of aged umber wood runs across the whole width; its top surface is a narrow band seen slightly from above, just below the middle of the picture exactly at the layout's height (its front edge at 47 percent of the height from the top); below it the bench's front is a calm, plain, dark umber plank face that fills the lower part of the screen. Behind the bench, a warm cream plaster wall, softly OUT OF FOCUS (a gentle depth-of-field blur), plain and quiet, with at most a faint blurred hint of a shelf edge far behind; no frames, no pictures. Upper left, a LOW BRASS LAMP hangs from above on a short stem: a small warm brass hood, its glow pooled on the bench top beneath it, a soft warm circle of light on the wood at the left, so the left of the bench is the brightest, warmest place on the screen; the light falls off gently to the right, where the wall and bench stay calm and dim for paper panels to sit on later.

The bench top and the wall are EMPTY: no pod, no dish, no books, no papers, no tools, no jars, no plants, no creatures, no props of any kind. Keep the area under the lamp perfectly clear, and keep the bench front plain and even, with no drawers, no handles, no carving, no knots. The painting fills the whole canvas edge to edge: NO dark bands, no bars, no letterbox at the top or the bottom.

NO text, letters, numbers, symbols, icons or interface. No frame, no vignette. Matte hand-painted miniature finish, one warm key light (the lamp) from the upper left, soft occlusion, low-saturation umber, cream and brass, never bright orange, no gloss, no chrome, no plastic.
